type l022Provider struct{}

func (l022Provider) CreateRoom(context.Context) (Room, error) {
	return Room{ID: "local-fixture", JoinURL: "https://telemost.yandex.ru/j/local-fixture"}, nil
}

type L022Peer struct {
	Secured *familysession.Session
	Mux *tcpforward.Mux
	Err error
}

type l022Gateway struct {
	endpoint familysession.PacketEndpoint
	raw []byte
	path string
	config tcpforward.MuxConfig
	setupID string
	identity Identity
	ready chan L022Peer
	event func(string)
}

func (gateway *l022Gateway) Start(_ context.Context, _ context.Context, _ Room, identifier string, identity Identity) (Gateway, error) {
	gateway.setupID, gateway.identity = identifier, identity
	return gateway, nil
}

func (gateway *l022Gateway) Close() error { return gateway.endpoint.Close() }

func (gateway *l022Gateway) Run(ctx context.Context, active func() error) error {
	secured, err := familysession.OpenMux(ctx, gateway.endpoint, gateway.raw, true, true)
	if err != nil { gateway.ready <- L022Peer{Err: err}; return err }
	defer secured.Close()
	if err = bindGateway(ctx, secured, gateway.setupID, gateway.identity, active); err != nil {
		gateway.ready <- L022Peer{Err: err}; return err
	}
	gateway.event("broker_bound")
	binding := ctx.Value(leaseKey{}).(*leaseBinding)
	handler := binding.handler(SessionAuthorizer(gateway.path, secured.ConnectionState()), secured.SecurityDeadline())
	gateway.config.LeaseRenewal = func(parent context.Context, stream *tcpforward.MuxStream) {
		handler(parent, stream)
		binding.broker.mu.Lock()
		sequence := binding.current.renewal
		binding.broker.mu.Unlock()
		if sequence > 0 { gateway.event("broker_extended") } else { gateway.event("broker_offer") }
	}
	mux, err := tcpforward.NewMux(ctx, secured, true, gateway.config)
	gateway.ready <- L022Peer{secured, mux, err}
	if err != nil { return err }
	defer func() {
		mux.Close()
		stats := mux.Stats()
		if stats.ActiveSockets != 0 || stats.ActiveStreams != 0 || stats.RetainedBytes != 0 { panic("fixture gateway resources") }
		gateway.event("broker_drained")
	}()
	return mux.Wait()
}

func L022Broker(ctx context.Context, endpoint familysession.PacketEndpoint, clientRaw, serverRaw []byte, path string,
	config tcpforward.MuxConfig, event func(string)) (*Broker, Descriptor, <-chan L022Peer, error) {
	var credentials familysession.Credentials
	if err := json.Unmarshal(clientRaw, &credentials); err != nil { return nil, Descriptor{}, nil, err }
	certificate, err := tls.X509KeyPair([]byte(credentials.Certificate), []byte(credentials.PrivateKey))
	if err != nil { return nil, Descriptor{}, nil, err }
	configuration, _, err := familysession.Configuration(clientRaw, false)
	if err != nil { return nil, Descriptor{}, nil, err }
	identity := Identity{Family: credentials.Family, Device: configuration.Certificates[0].Leaf.Subject.SerialNumber}
	copy(identity.PublicKey[:], certificate.PrivateKey.(ed25519.PrivateKey).Public().(ed25519.PublicKey))
	authorize := func(context.Context) (Identity, error) { return identity, nil }
	gateway := &l022Gateway{endpoint: endpoint, raw: serverRaw, path: path, config: config, ready: make(chan L022Peer, 1), event: event}
	limits := DefaultLimits()
	limits.Lifetime = 8 * time.Second
	broker, err := New(l022Provider{}, gateway, limits, nil)
	if err != nil { return nil, Descriptor{}, nil, err }
	identifier, err := broker.Challenge(ctx, authorize)
	if err != nil { broker.Close(); return nil, Descriptor{}, nil, err }
	descriptor, err := broker.Create(ctx, identifier, authorize)
	if err == nil { err = broker.Claim(ctx, identifier, authorize) }
	if err != nil { broker.Close(); return nil, Descriptor{}, nil, err }
	return broker, descriptor, gateway.ready, nil
}
